mechanism_narrative: A negative 1-month change in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with negative FEDFUNDS change are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index above 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite positive CPI change, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that precedes Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDP growth above 2.5% and housing starts above 1100), the S&P 500 is vulnerable to correction due to overvaluation and Fed tightening risk, leading to negative forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in INDPRO decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month decline in housing starts above 5% signals residential sector contraction, a leading indicator of economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a 'high inflation, low rate' regime that precedes Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime (defined by unemployment rate below 4.0% and payroll employment above 140000), Fed tightening to combat inflationary pressures from tight labor conditions leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
